formula: output[i] = REDC32(sum(j=0..7, window.word[8+i-j] * b[j])) reduced once by 2P

input_contract.weighted_window_word_0_to_7: 0 <= x <= P; P is a reachable lazy zero from odd fill_windows when wa=0
input_contract.b_word_0_to_7: 0 <= x < P; forward-bottom outputs are canonical
input_contract.word16: existing zero sentinel not read by IFMA core

carry_rule: Each IFMA operand is zero-extended uint32 (<2^30 here), hence exactly representable in 52 bits. madd52lo collects low 52 product bits in uint64 without masking accumulated carries; madd52hi collects each product >>52. Combine full lo + (hi<<52), so lo>>52 carry is preserved. Both accumulators and the reconstruction are bounded before 64-bit overflow. The later 32-bit Montgomery add is also bounded below 2^64; conversion to eight uint32 lanes loses no bits.
reads: Each IFMA window vector loads exactly eight uint32 words starting at 8-j for j=0..7, so all reads lie in word[1..15]; b is eight scalar uint32 loads. No extra input padding is introduced.
unsupported_range: Arbitrary independent [0,2P) values in both unweighted window and b are outside the existing leaf contract and can overflow the old 64-bit exact sum. Public lazy Mint inputs are accepted by existing transforms and become canonical before the leaf; weighted P remains supported.
